(1) women entrepreneurs tend to be older, more educated, more often married, more often with children and less often with a spouse who is employed; (2) women entrepreneurs tend not to be as active in their businesses as male entrepreneurs; (3) women entrepreneurs are more often self-employed in the services sector, while men entrepreneurs are more often in the retail trade; and (4) women entrepreneurs are less likely to have started their own businesses than men entrepreneurs
